page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The host utilizes an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware resources are allocated across 16 dedicated virtual CPUs, backed by 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, alongside 48 MB of L3 cache and support for AVX-512 vector extensions. System memory amounts to 60 GB of RAM, equivalent to 3.75 GB per vCPU, and network throughput delivers a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include bundled local disk storage, necessitating network-attached block storage for operating system images and persistent application data. While general compute and memory throughput metrics fall within the middle 50 percent in baseline CPU and compression benchmarks, the A10 accelerator places the instance into the top tier for machine learning inference tasks, reaching 2,480 prompt tokens per second and over 90 text generation tokens per second on 7B parameter models.

Cost efficiency is centered around specialized visual and inference acceleration, serving as a lower-overhead alternative to larger data center accelerators like the A100. A key architectural tradeoff is the 24 GB VRAM ceiling, which confines standalone deep learning workloads to small and medium models while excluding larger architectures such as 70B models without distributed setups. The instance is suited for AI inference serving, real-time video processing, graphics rendering, and computer vision pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for visual processing and machine learning inference. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with an x86_64 architecture, it delivers 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores running at 2.9 GHz, paired with 60 GB of system memory and 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Compute acceleration is handled by a single dedicated NVIDIA A10 GPU featuring 24 GB of Ampere VRAM. The instance does not provide bundled local storage, requiring external cloud storage. Benchmark metrics show standard middle-tier performance on general CPU tasks alongside top-decile throughput in small and medium large language model inference workloads. The hardware profile offers balanced cost efficiency for inference tasks that do not justify heavier enterprise training accelerators. The platform fits AI inference pipelines, video processing, image generation, and remote visual rendering services.
